target: the same hole reaches pr-open on a hardened spec without a hardened review report
cmd: bash "$FIXTURES/tracker-gates/mkspec.sh" specs 901 reviewing hardened; if FACTORY_SPECS_DIR=$PWD/specs bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" claim reviewing pr-open who >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo BYPASSED; else echo REFUSED; fi
